trades.name: Failure to sustain above 25686-25700
trades.quote: Short NQ on a failure to sustain above 686-700, targeting 662 and 646 as initial targets. Simply monitor for continuation from there given today was an inside day.

trades.name: Failure to sustain above 6880-6883

This would effectively be the same as yesterday after the “spike for ants.” We can be short looking for a test of the single prints but may need to consider flipping long.

trades.name: Hold of single prints (6858-6864) leading to reclaim of 6866
trades.quote: Long ES on a hold of the single prints which leads to a reclaim of 6866. I’m willing to enter directly within the singles if I see responsive buying, and will be prepared to get flat or take profit to protect a stop if 66 rejects from below.

trades.name: React long at 6852 (6852-6858)
trades.quote: I can’t plan on taking a long at 52 (or between 52 and 58) until I see the action real time. It is risky to do so but there are a couple ticks of single prints between 52 and 53 which protects today’s IB high. There should be a fair amount of trapped sellers from today’s IB so there should be a reaction. I’m willing to react, but it is a risky trade until back over 66 and stronger buyers would not let the singles fully fill. Keep that in mind and read the action real time before considering.

trades.name: Scalp long at 6821-6824 after taking out today's low
trades.quote: I would still keep an eye on the 21-24 area if we take out today’s low on ES. It may be good for at least a scalp but seeing it would represent a break in structure on the 30 minute so temper expectations.
